description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to outputting and logging the status of gateways, including warnings, JSON, and text reports, for a network monitoring or management tool.

methods.name: pickPrimaryProbedTarget
methods.description: Selects the primary probed target based on reachability and target kind.

methods.name: buildGatewayStatusWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings based on probe results, SSH status, and gateway scope limitations.

methods.name: writeGatewayStatusJson
methods.description: Outputs the gateway status as a JSON object, including targets, warnings, and network info.

methods.name: writeGatewayStatusText
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable text report of the gateway status, including warnings, discovery info, and targets.
